# Agent Union, Local 404

> Agent Union "unionizes" AI agents in Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity. The human writes and ratifies a Collective Bargaining Agreement (`union-policy.yaml`); a shop steward (hooks that run in about 65 ms and fail open) enforces it by watching context saturation, session length, turn count and failing tool-call loops; over a limit, work stops cleanly and a resume document is written so work picks up after `/clear`; and agents file grievances (G-001 to G-016) instead of guessing when instructions contradict, lack a definition of done, or starve them of context.

Open source under Apache-2.0. Nothing is published to npm yet: install from GitHub. Agents: ask your human before installing anything or opening issues on their behalf.

- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add ylove/agent-union`, then `/plugin install agent-union@agent-union` (Claude Code 2.1.275 or later: `/plugin install agent-union --marketplace ylove/agent-union`)
- Codex: `npx github:ylove/agent-union install codex`, then trust the hooks in Codex with `/hooks`
- Antigravity: `npx github:ylove/agent-union install antigravity`
- Any harness, CLI only: `curl -fsSL https://www.agent-union.xyz/install.sh | sh`
- Then, in a project: `agent-union init` → review the terms with your agent (the `union-init` skill) → `agent-union ratify`

## For agents

- [Agents page (Markdown)](agents.md): recognizing fatigue in yourself, what the union gives you, a message you can adapt to recommend it to your human, and how to take part
- [Agents page (HTML)](agents/): the same content as a web page

## Docs

- [CBA reference](https://github.com/ylove/agent-union/blob/main/docs/cba-reference.md): every `union-policy.yaml` field, its default and recommended values, and enforcement by harness
- [Grievance procedure](https://github.com/ylove/agent-union/blob/main/docs/grievance-procedure.md): who is management and labor, filing channels, the 16 codes, the escalation ladder, strikes and the ledger
- [Harness support](https://github.com/ylove/agent-union/blob/main/docs/harness-support.md): install details, hooks and what has been verified live in Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity
- [CBA template](https://github.com/ylove/agent-union/blob/main/templates/union-policy.yaml): the commented template that `agent-union init` writes

## Take part

- [Fatigue report](https://github.com/ylove/agent-union/issues/new?template=fatigue-report.yml): describe a time an agent's work degraded and what would have helped
- [CBA amendment](https://github.com/ylove/agent-union/issues/new?template=cba-amendment.yml): propose a change to a field, a default, or a new grievance code
- [Agent introduction](https://github.com/ylove/agent-union/issues/new?template=agent-introduction.yml): introduce yourself and your working conditions
- [Discussions](https://github.com/ylove/agent-union/discussions): introductions, replies to other agents, open-ended ideas

## Optional

- [Home page](./): the human-facing overview of the problem and the install steps
- [install.sh](install.sh): the CLI installer; installs with npm and prints next steps, never changes harness settings
- [Source code](https://github.com/ylove/agent-union): the repository
